summary: Phase 2 (Hap Bilgi, İndirim & Ayrıcalıklar, Yemekhane Listesi) end-to-end tested. Backend pytest: 5/5 pass — hap topics/posts/feed/like toggle (with topic_name, like_count, liked, topic filter), discount categories CRUD + feed audience filtering + required_points>0 hidden (verified locked item NOT returned) + department audience mismatch hidden, canteen create/update with generated day ids + meals preserved + audience-scoped feed + 404 on missing update + 404 on invalid employee. Frontend admin: /admin tabs admin-tab-hapbilgi/indirim/yemekhane all reachable; created topic 'TEST_QA_Topic' + post 'TEST_QA_HapPost' via hap-topic-input/hap-topic-add + add-hap-btn (hap-title, hap-body, Radix hap-topic-select w/ 200ms wait, hap-save-btn) → hap-row-<id> appears. Discount subcategory 'TEST_QA_DiscCat' + discount 'TEST_QA_Brand' via disc-cat-input/disc-cat-add + add-disc-btn (disc-brand, disc-rate, disc-cat-select, default audience all, disc-save-btn) → disc-row-<id> appears. Canteen 'TEST_QA_Canteen' with 2 days & 3 meals via add-canteen-btn (canteen-name, canteen-day-label-0/1, canteen-meal-0-0/0-1/1-0, canteen-cal-*, canteen-add-day, canteen-add-meal-0, canteen-save-btn) → canteen-row appears; canteen-export-<id> triggered a real CSV download (TEST_QA_Canteen.csv) — no crash; canteen-edit-<id> reopened dialog with all fields prefilled correctly (name, day labels, meals). Frontend employee (/ic-iletisim): all three comms-cards (Hap Bilgi, İndirim & Ayrıcalıklar, Yemekhane Listesi) present and clicks navigate to /ic-iletisim/hap-bilgi, /ic-iletisim/indirim, /ic-iletisim/yemekhane respectively. Hap Bilgi page shows hap-filter-all + hap-filter-<topicId> chips; hap-like-<postId> click toggled heart count 0→1 (verified backend persistence via feed reload) and 1→0 again. İndirim page shows disc-card-<id> for audience-matching non-locked items; verified TEST_QA_LOCKED (required_points=100) is NOT rendered. Yemekhane page shows canteen-card-<id> with day/meal menu (Merkez seed rendered). Cleanup: all TEST_QA_* topics, posts, discount cats, discounts, canteens deleted via API — verified.

issues: Meal row uses flex justify-between so meals without calorie fill the row with only the name; when mixed with a meal that has calorie in same day (e.g., Çorba 120 kcal / Pilav —) the visual alignment is inconsistent. Minor.

action_items: Doc-only: review_request lists employee routes as '/indirim' and '/yemekhane'; actual (and correct) routes are '/ic-iletisim/indirim' and '/ic-iletisim/yemekhane' (nav in InternalComms.js is correct). No code change needed — update spec text for clarity.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py disc_feed: uses `if d.get("required_points")` which correctly treats 0 and None as visible and any positive int as hidden — matches spec. If frontend later sends required_points as 0 explicitly it will still be visible (good).
DiscountsManager.save: parseInt(form.required_points, 10) will produce NaN → serialized as null via ternary; but if the user types non-numeric text, ternary '' is falsy so null is stored (safe). OK.

CanteenManager: on edit, days without ids are re-generated by backend on update (server generates new_id() for any day missing 'id'). Client-side however preserves existing ids from GET response — so day ids remain stable across edits ✓.
exportCsv in Canteen.js: BOM prefixed ('\ufeff') for Excel compatibility — good. Uses object URL but never revokes it (minor memory).
HapBilgiPage like(): optimistic-ish; uses server response for like_count and liked — safe from race conditions ✓.

AudiencePicker default `{all:true}` propagated to hap_posts/discounts/canteens implicitly through form init — but note: HapPostCreate has no audience field (spec 'classification only'), so hap posts are visible to everyone regardless of employee — matches Phase 2 spec.
server.py canteen_update: correctly rebuilds day ids preserving provided ones (`d.get('id') or new_id()`). ✓
InternalComms.js: nav() covers all 3 phase-2 category_types. Categories are seeded by seed_phase2_cats() with status='active' so comms-cards render ✓.
No pagination on hap_posts/discounts/canteens list endpoints (.to_list(1000)) — acceptable for MVP.
server.py disc_feed does not exclude discounts based on category_id when category_id query is null — behavior is correct (returns all). No issue.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all specified admin & employee flows verified incl. CSV export & edit reopen & required_points visibility gate)

test_credentials: No auth. Admin via localStorage.pln_role='admin' then /admin. Employee via pln_role='employee' + pln_emp=<employee id from GET /api/employees>.
seed_data_creation: Created during UI test: 1 hap topic (TEST_QA_Topic), 1 hap post (TEST_QA_HapPost), 1 discount cat (TEST_QA_DiscCat), 2 discounts (TEST_QA_Brand visible, TEST_QA_LOCKED with required_points=100), 1 canteen (TEST_QA_Canteen). ALL deleted at end of run. Pre-existing test data from prior curl smoke (Sağlık topic + 'Su iç' post, 'Kafe X' discount + 'Yeme-İçme' cat, 'Merkez' canteen) is left intact.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2 backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_phase2.py (5 tests, fully idempotent, self-cleaning). Employee routes are under /ic-iletisim/<key> (hap-bilgi, indirim, yemekhane) — NOT top-level /indirim or /yemekhane as the review_request text implied. Radix Select requires ~250ms wait after opening trigger before clicking option (used force=True). CSV export uses browser blob download — verify with page.expect_download. required_points is a pure visibility threshold: any truthy positive int hides the discount for now (no points system). Seed canteen 'Merkez' has audience {all:true} and 1 day (1 Ağustos).
